## Summary

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix (signature mismatch, crash, incorrect behavior)
- [ ] New feature (e.g. support for a new IDA build)

## Checklist

- [ ] No new runtime dependencies (standard library only).
- [ ] Tests added/updated under `tests/` where relevant.
- [ ] [CHANGELOG.md](../CHANGELOG.md) updated.
- [ ] No secrets, real license files, or full `ida.dll` binaries included.
